entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Morgana went into Okumura's[n]Palace? Is that true, Futaba?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: He did say he'd go alone.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Does that mean he's in danger?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The chances of that are[n]highly likely.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yeah. We should all go[n]in after him.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The Palace is most likely at[n]their corporate headquarters.[n]I'll look into it a little more.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We gotta look into those[n]mental shutdown things too.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'd prefer a little more caution,[n]but this is an emergency...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Then we'll go tomorrow.[n]Don't forget, everyone.
